name: codelab-runner
description: Interactive server of the CodeLab plugins for Moodle: runs programs (25 server languages including C, C++, Python, Java, C#, JS/TS, Go, Rust, R, Ruby, Lua, Kotlin, Perl, Octave, Julia, Scheme, Dart, Scala, Elixir, Swift, SQL) in a sandbox.
author: Boban Blagojević

scripts.test:unit: node --test test/token.test.mjs test/queue.test.mjs test/cache.test.mjs test/deploy.test.mjs test/main.test.mjs test/errors.test.mjs test/files.test.mjs test/compiler.test.mjs test/compat.test.mjs test/analysis.test.mjs
